resources.description: A multi-scale deep learning model for multi-animal pose estimation with data-driven skeleton assembly, keypoint detection, part affinity fields (PAFs), and animal reidentification (reID). The model is adapted from ImageNet-pretrained ResNets and EfficientNets and uses customized deconvolution layers to predict keypoint locations and connections. It achieves high accuracy in localizing keypoints and assembling individuals from multiple animals in a scene.
